=== short branches both ways
start:
        bz start
        bnz 1f
        br 1f
        bsa 1f
        nop
1:      bge start
        blt 1b
=== jr and jarl to labels
top:    jr top
        jarl top, lp
        jarl next, r10
        nop
next:   jr top
=== conditional branch relaxes to an inverted branch over jr
        bnz far
        bz far
        bgt far
        .space 0x200
far:    nop
=== br relaxes to jr, bsa to its 8-byte form
        br far
        bsa far
        jbr far
        .space 0x200
far:    nop
=== backward branches past the 9-bit reach
back:   nop
        .space 0x100
        bz back
        br back
        bsa back
=== the boundaries of the short branch
        bz fwd
        .space 0xfa
fwd:    nop
back:   .space 0xfe
        bz back
=== one past the boundaries
        bz fwd
        .space 0xfc
fwd:    nop
back:   .space 0x100
        bz back
=== a relaxed branch pushes a later one out of range
        bz a
        bz b
        .space 0xf8
a:      nop
b:      nop
=== branches to an undefined symbol far from the section start
        .space 0x10000
        bz ext
        br ext
        bsa ext
        jr ext
        jarl ext, lp
=== hi() and lo() of a .set constant, at the carry boundary
        .set addr, 0x12348000
        movhi hi(addr), r0, r1
        movea lo(addr), r1, r1
        .set addr2, 0x12347fff
        movhi hi(addr2), r0, r1
        movea lo(addr2), r1, r1
        .set addr3, 0xffff8000
        movhi hi(addr3), r0, r1
        movea lo(addr3), r1, r1
=== hi() and lo() of symbols leave the fields to relocations
        movhi hi(foo), r0, r1
        movea lo(foo), r1, r1
        movhi hi0(foo), r0, r1
        movea foo, r0, r1
        ld.b lo(foo)[r1], r2
        ld.w lo(foo)[r1], r2
        st.h r3, lo(foo)[r1]
        jarl foo, lp
=== label differences resolve
start:  movea end - start, r0, r1
        addi end - start, r1, r1
        ld.w (end - start)[r1], r2
        nop
end:
=== data widths
        .byte 1, 2
        .short 0x1234
        .word 0x12345678
        .long 0x9abcdef0
=== comments and statement separators
        mov r1, r2    # a comment
        mov r3, r4; mov r5, r6
# a whole-line comment
        nop
=== alignment pads with nop
# GNU as also pads the end of a section to its alignment, which rsasm does
# not, so the code after the directive fills the last 8 bytes itself.
        mov r1, r2
        halt
        .p2align 3
        nop
        movea 1, r0, r1
        nop
=== an interrupt handler
handler:
        st.w r1, -4[sp]
        add -4, sp
        ldsr r1, eipc
        shl 2, r1
        ld.w 0[sp], r1
        add 4, sp
        reti
=== a copy loop
        movhi hi(0x12340000), r0, r6
        movea lo(0x12340000), r6, r6
        movea 16, r0, r7
1:      sld.b 0[ep], r8
        st.b r8, 0[r6]
        add 1, r6
        add -1, r7
        bnz 1b
        jmp [lp]
=== .v850e3v5 and .v850 switch the instruction set
        mov r1, r2
        .v850e3v5
        callt 3
        mov 16, r1
        .v850
        mov 5, r1
